reset.title: Reset progress
reset.body: This deletes all your stamps and journey steps on this phone. Your language stays the same.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.note: Your stamps and settings are saved only on this phone. We never save where you are.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.comingSoon: The full privacy notice is coming soon.

location.explainer: We use your location only to show how far places are and to confirm your check-ins. It is never saved.
location.denied: Location is turned off for this site. You can still use the guide. To collect gold stamps, turn location on in your browser settings.
location.unavailable: We could not find your location. Try again outside, away from tall buildings.

checkin.readingHint: This can take up to 10 seconds. Hold your phone still.
checkin.unknownPlace: We could not find this place.

too_far.title: Not there yet
too_far.body: You are about {{distance}} m away. Get within {{radius}} m and try again.

poor_signal.title: Weak GPS signal
poor_signal.body: Step outside, away from tall buildings, and try again.

no_permission.title: Location is off
no_permission.body: Without location we can't confirm you are here. You can still get an outline stamp. To earn a gold one, turn location on in your browser settings and try again.

outline.title: Outline stamp added
outline.body: Come back with location on to turn it gold.

too_soon.title: Just a moment
too_soon.body: You collected a gold stamp very recently. Please wait a minute and try again.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn't check you in this time. Please try again.
